description: This file contains a Go test suite for creating and managing Android CVD instances as part of an end-to-end test. It includes test setup, calling external services, uploading images, and verifying responses.

methods.name: TestInstance
methods.description: Main test function that sets up the environment, uploads images, creates a CVD instance, and verifies its status.

methods.name: uploadImages
methods.description: Uploads image files to a remote directory by unzipping an archive locally and then uploading each file.

methods.name: runCmd
methods.description: Runs a shell command with provided arguments, captures standard error, and returns error if the command fails.
